description: This file contains internal test utilities and test case classes for testing autocast behavior in PyTorch, including lists of operations and arguments for different device types (CUDA and CPU) and data types, as well as methods for running autocast tests.

classes.name: AutocastTestLists
classes.description: Contains lists of operations and arguments for testing autocast behavior on CUDA devices.

classes.name: AutocastCPUTestLists
classes.description: Contains lists of operations and arguments for testing autocast behavior on CPU devices.

classes.name: TestAutocast
classes.description: Test case class providing methods to run autocast tests and compare results for different data types and device types.

methods.name: args_maybe_kwargs
methods.description: Helper to extract operation name, arguments, and optional keyword arguments from a tuple.

methods.name: _run_autocast_outofplace
methods.description: Runs an autocast operation out-of-place, compares results with and without autocast, and verifies correctness and consistency.
